sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At its core, Run Giant 3D is an endless runner game where you control a giant character as you navigate through various environments. The gameplay is simple yet addictive, requiring you to tap the screen to move left or right and collect items of the same color to increase your size and strength. The larger you become, the more powerful your attacks become, and the farther you'll be able to run.

One of the key features of Run Giant 3D is its item collection system. As you run, you'll encounter various items, each with its own color and point value. Collecting items of the same color will increase your size and strength, while collecting items of different colors will decrease your size and leave you vulnerable to attacks. This creates a sense of strategy and risk-reward, as you weigh the benefits of collecting items against the potential risks of losing size and strength.

Another important aspect of Run Giant 3D is its combat system. As you grow larger, you'll encounter enemies who will try to stop you. You can use your attacks to defeat these enemies and continue your run. The combat system is simple yet satisfying, requiring you to time your attacks perfectly to eliminate your foes.

In addition to its core gameplay mechanics, Run Giant 3D also features a variety of power-ups and bonuses. These can be collected by tapping on them when they appear on the screen. Power-ups can increase your size, strength, or speed, while bonuses can provide temporary shields or boosts to your attacks. These can be a game-changer in tight spots, especially when facing tough enemies or navigating treacherous terrain.
